description: This file is a header file defining the interface for name hashing functionality related to an index state and cache entries, including function declarations for directory and file existence checks, case adjustments, and hash management.

methods.name: index_dir_find
methods.description: Finds a directory index entry by name within an index state, returning an integer status or position.

methods.name: index_dir_exists
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists in the index state given its name and length, using the index_dir_find function.

methods.name: adjust_dirname_case
methods.description: Adjusts the case of a directory name within the index state.

methods.name: index_file_exists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists in the index state given its name and length, considering case insensitivity if specified.

methods.name: test_lazy_init_name_hash
methods.description: Performs a test or initialization for the name hash, possibly with threading considerations.

methods.name: add_name_hash
methods.description: Adds a name hash entry for a cache entry within the index state.

methods.name: remove_name_hash
methods.description: Removes a name hash entry for a cache entry within the index state.

methods.name: free_name_hash
methods.description: Frees or clears all name hash entries associated with the index state.
